subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should Google Meet talkback unconditionally fail closed whenever microphone state is unknown across both local Chrome and paired-node transports?
rationale: The previous behavior treated unknown state as usable, while this PR intentionally changes that fallback and may block existing setups whose Meet DOM state is not observable; repository policy requires explicit ownership of that compatibility choice.

options.title: Adopt strict readiness everywhere
options.body: Require `micMuted === false` before every local or paired-node bridge startup and merge only after transport-parity tests and live proof.

options.title: Preserve compatibility by default
options.body: Keep the shipped unknown-state fallback as the default and add an explicitly selected strict policy with coverage for both modes.

options.title: Split the policy change
options.body: Land transcript and recovery fixes separately while pausing the microphone-policy portion for dedicated product and upgrade review.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict readiness everywhere
recommendation.body: Require `micMuted === false` before every local or paired-node bridge startup and merge only after transport-parity tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the shared meeting-bot runtime and recorded the unknown-microphone policy as a deferred follow-up in the merged extraction.
